summary: Contestants will organize and deliver a well-structured, extemporaneous speech on a business-related topic with limited preparation time. They will draw two topics, select one, and have up to ten minutes to prepare a two to four minute speech using only provided notecards. The event evaluates organization, delivery, effectiveness, and adherence to time and material rules.
time_limits: No more than ten (10) minutes preparation
No less than two (2) and no more than four (4) minutes speech
Warnings given at two (2) minutes and one (1) minute remaining during speaking time
SPEECH WILL BE STOPPED AT FOUR (4) MINUTES
competencies: Demonstrate clear, professional, and effective oral communication when presenting ideas
Organize the speech using a clear introduction, body, and conclusion to create a coherent message
Use appropriate tempo, pitch, and vocal variety to enhance clarity and audience engagement
Use purposeful nonverbal gestures, posture, and eye contact to support confident delivery
Analyze the assigned topic quickly and develop key points supported by logical reasoning, examples, and relevant business insights
Adapt tone, language, and delivery to meet audience expectations
Use effective opening and closing statements to strengthen the overall message
Demonstrate professionalism, confidence, and ethical communication while presenting under pressure

rubric.description: If any question results in a NO, please assign a score of 0
Contestant maintains good eye contact, uses appropriate gestures and body language, and varies their tone and pace adequately.
The speech content flows adequately, with a mostly clear structure and smooth transitions between points.

The speech comprehensively addresses the topic with a clear and focused approach. It includes relevant information that directly relates to the given context. The purpose of the speech (to decide, to impress, to inform, to persuade) is effectively achieved with clarity and impact.
The speech lasted no less than two (2) minutes and no more than four (4) minutes and the contestant did not use any materials other than those specified.

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
eligibility_notes: Any secondary division contestant may enter this judged event.
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
